description: Set a contact's conversation CATEGORY (single label). Pass an empty string to clear it. See gambot_list_conversation_categories for the available labels. This is distinct from tags (use gambot_update_contact_tags for many-to-many tags).

category.description: Category label; empty string clears it.

phone.description: Phone number, ideally E.164 international format (country code, digits only, no leading 0), e.g. 972501234567 or 12025551234. A local/national number (e.g. leading 0) is accepted when a country is provided — or when the organization has a saved country from onboarding; otherwise it's rejected as ambiguous.

name: gambot_set_contact_category
title: Set contact conversation category
